Forge Pro 1.0.1

Build 202608292024 · commit b65ef8d7 · stable channel

  • Fixed: sending a message no longer jumps the thread to the middle — chrome transitions after a send re-anchor to the tail instead of unpinning the follow.
  • Fixed: a fast flick right after the composer resizes is respected as a scroll again (the re-anchor grace no longer swallows it).
  • New: a Claude account card in Provider settings — live signed-in status, one-tap re-authenticate with code paste-back, no terminal needed.
  • Fixed: the stale authentication-error banner clears when a re-sign-in actually completes, and a run that fails on authentication now says so and points at Settings.
  • Fixed: interrupting a run shows "aborted", never "failed".
  • New: live agent output in the agent sheet — see what each subagent is doing while it runs; the feed keeps following past long histories.
  • Fixed: background tasks show Running instead of a permanent Queued.
  • Fixed: the streaming caret rides inline at the end of the prose instead of hopping on its own line, and can no longer be copied with the text.
  • Fixed: attached photo thumbnails only show the checkmark when the attachment was actually taken; rapid double-taps no longer double-attach.
  • Fixed: cached threads from older builds load again instead of re-hydrating from scratch; large agent fleets no longer disable thread caching.
  • Fixed: Settings no longer flickers or vanishes when a surface auto-raises behind it on iPhone.
  • Fixed: reconnecting to a different server clears the previous server's sign-in state and re-checks account validity.
  • Fixed: the up-to-date git bar drops its redundant explanation line.

Forge Pro 1.0.1

Build 202608281455 · stable channel

  • Third-party notices now include the Swift packages linked into the app (swift-markdown, swift-cmark) and ship with the iOS app as well.
  • Settings › General gains the automatic-updates toggle with the current channel and a Check for Updates button.
  • The update channel chosen in Settings is honoured from launch; changes made by the updater itself are reflected in Settings.
  • Release pipeline hardening: signed Sparkle helper tools, notarization fixes, non-arm64 native prebuilds pruned, a build number that can only increase, and older releases keep their download links.

Forge Pro 1.0.0

Build 202608281424 · commit b191a21 · stable channel

  • First release on the update feed.
